title: Discover
copy: A conversation about what you need, who it's for, and what success looks like. You get a clear proposal and quote.

title: Plan
copy: Concept, script, schedule, and shot list, plus where every piece will live once it's out in the world.

title: Produce
copy: Directing, shooting, interviews, and design, handled by a small crew that moves fast and treats people well.

title: Review
copy: Every cut goes on VidShare, my own review tool. You open one link, with no login, and leave your notes on the exact frame.

title: Deliver & grow
copy: The final cut, every cutdown and format you need, and a plan for getting it seen.
